system.description: Prime Requisites: Strength and Intelligence. Other Requirements: Intelligence score of 9 or more. Experience Bonus: 5% for Strength of 13 or better and Intelligence of 13-15, 10% for Strength of 13 or better and Intelligence of 16-18. Hit Dice: 1d6 per level up to 9th level. 10th level, + 1 hit point, and Constitution adjustment does not apply. Maximum Level: 10. Armor: All; shields permitted. Weapons: Any.
